answer_1.quote: We propose HERCULES, a method for aggregating user reviews into textual summaries ... The goal of review aggregation is to identify the majority or frequent opinions from a set of diverse inputs.

answer_2.quote: We use ROUGE F1, R-2/R-L, an automatic Question Answering (QA) pipeline ... we also evaluate the extent to which the generated summaries are entailed ... using SummaC.

answer_3.quote: We use an automatic Question Answering (QA) pipeline ... using a QA model based on ELECTRA. We also use BART for question generation and FlairNLP for answer extraction.

answer_4.quote: We recruited crowdworkers through Amazon Mechanical Turk, showed them a reference summary and ... solicited pairwise preferences along three dimensions: Informativeness, Conciseness & Non-Redundancy, and Coherence & Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Pairwise preference task where annotators compare system outputs on Informativeness, Conciseness & Non-Redundancy, and Coherence & Fluency.
